evidence.title: The Vanished Comet Negative
evidence.description: The padded case is empty. Its waxed sleeve was opened cleanly, without tearing the paper seal around the cabinet.

evidence.title: Unforced Plate-Case Lock
evidence.description: The brass lock has no tool marks. Someone opened the case with its duplicate dome key.

evidence.title: The 22:45 Telescope Entry
evidence.description: The log records a final focus adjustment at 22:45, the last time the plate was listed in the dome.

evidence.title: Blue-Silica Footprints
evidence.description: A fresh trail crosses the dome floor from the case to the service arch. The blue grit is used only on the observatory roof.

evidence.title: Duplicate Dome Key on the Register Ring
evidence.description: A brass key ring is hidden behind the chart register. The darkroom key is there; the sign-out beside the duplicate dome key bears Dr. Vane's initials.

evidence.title: The Publisher's Cable
evidence.description: A terse cable demands repayment of Elias Vane's private advance before the end of the month.

evidence.title: Ada's Sealed Accession
evidence.description: Ada's wax seal closes the accession book across the 22:45 entry. The archive record was written in her hand.

evidence.title: Silica in Elias's Boots
evidence.description: The director's observing boots carry the same blue roof grit as the tracks across the dome.

evidence.title: Emulsion on the Director's Gloves
evidence.description: A trace of silver emulsion marks gloves monogrammed with Elias Vane's comet pin.

evidence.title: The Steady Dynamo
evidence.description: The gauge never dipped at 22:45. Mira's grease-marked log puts her at the generator when the negative vanished.

evidence.title: Ada's Archive Alibi
evidence.description: Ada says she stayed in the chart archive through the 22:45 accession.
evidence.note: A statement attributed to Ada, not an objective fact.

evidence.title: Ada Saw Elias Leave the Dome
evidence.description: Ada saw the director on the dome stair at 22:45 carrying an empty negative sleeve.
evidence.note: Testimony is recorded as testimony and only supports deductions alongside other evidence.

evidence.title: Elias's Archive Alibi
evidence.description: Elias insists he was among the star charts at 22:45 and never entered the dome.
evidence.note: A claim, not a fact about the world; only usable through alibi reasoning.

evidence.title: Mira's Generator Alibi
evidence.description: Mira says she stayed with the dynamo at 22:45. The machine log supports her account.
evidence.note: A claim corroborated by the dynamo log, not a conclusion about guilt.
